learning_outcomes.text: Students will gain knowledge about social and historical processes.
Students will analyze and understand the historical and cultural context we live in from a broader perspective and in comparison with Western civilization.
Students will learn to look at history with a much deeper perspective.
Students will learn to use academic language.
Students will learn historical development by comparing it with other examples.

syllabus_topics: The end of feudalism and the early modern period
Geographical discoveries, mercantilism and price revolution
Centralization, the Birth of the Modern State
Formation of nations, nationalism, colonialism and imperialism
Dissolution of empires, socialism and the October Revolution
Two World Wars and the interwar period
Modernization movements in the Ottoman Empire and the establishment of the Republic
